cases.symptom: Reference quickstart health check completes and evidence is current.
cases.safeNextAction: Keep the accepted quickstart fixture id with the guide and avoid broadening the claim beyond the recorded proof mode.
cases.customerSafeWording: The quickstart fixture is current and no escalation is needed from this guide entry.
cases.escalationRoute: No escalation; revisit if freshness or proof-mode evidence changes.
accessibilityNotes: Healthy status is stated in text and does not depend on green color alone.

cases.symptom: Local install or bootstrap preflight fails before the first project exists.
cases.safeNextAction: Run the supported bootstrap preflight again after environment repair; do not install tools from the guide automatically.
cases.customerSafeWording: Your local environment is missing a supported prerequisite. Keep the preflight output and follow the supported setup path.
cases.escalationRoute: Support Workflow when the supported preflight remains blocked.
accessibilityNotes: The missing prerequisite and safe retry are named before any command block.

cases.symptom: CLI or MCP command cannot find a valid workload SVID or agent principal.
cases.safeNextAction: Refresh the fixture principal or route to identity support; never paste tokens or private key material into the guide.
cases.customerSafeWording: Authentication evidence is missing or expired. The next step is identity handoff, not credential sharing.
cases.escalationRoute: Identity support with redacted principal fingerprint and correlation id.
accessibilityNotes: The blocked auth state is textual and includes the correlation id location.

cases.symptom: Plan preview is blocked by capacity, compatibility, or missing approval evidence.
cases.safeNextAction: Keep the Gatekeeper reason, required approval, and cost/capacity evidence together before asking for review.
cases.customerSafeWording: The plan is blocked pending review evidence. No deployment has been attempted.
cases.escalationRoute: Plan/Diff review owner with Gatekeeper reason and proof-mode label.
accessibilityNotes: Blocked reason, reviewer, and next action are written as separate lines.

cases.symptom: Deploy run fails after acceptance begins and needs owner routing.
cases.safeNextAction: Collect the deployment-set id, failed resource, and correlation id; do not perform live repair from the guide.
cases.customerSafeWording: The deploy reference failed and needs operator review with a redacted evidence pack.
cases.escalationRoute: Operators/SRE with deployment-set id and redacted failure envelope.
accessibilityNotes: Failure state, owner, and no-live-repair boundary are visible in plain text.

cases.symptom: Policy denies the requested action or capability.
cases.safeNextAction: Show the denied action, policy id, and required approval path; do not describe bypass instructions.
cases.customerSafeWording: A policy rule blocked the action. The safe path is approval or a scoped change request.
cases.escalationRoute: Security review with policy id, decision id, and redacted subject.
accessibilityNotes: Denied state does not rely on red color and includes approval route text.

cases.symptom: Troubleshooting evidence is stale, unknown, or not backed by an accepted fixture.
cases.safeNextAction: Mark the answer stale, collect current fixture evidence, and stop before making readiness claims.
cases.customerSafeWording: The evidence is not current enough to use as a readiness signal.
cases.escalationRoute: Docs maintainer for fixture refresh; Support if a customer workflow is blocked.
accessibilityNotes: Staleness duration and stop condition are present in text.

cases.symptom: Requested troubleshooting action is outside v1 support or launch claims.
cases.safeNextAction: Route to known limitations and do not describe unsupported behavior as available.
cases.customerSafeWording: That request is outside the current supported path. The guide can record the limitation and follow-up owner.
cases.escalationRoute: Cutline owner for accepted-risk or follow-up routing.
accessibilityNotes: Unsupported state is explicit and includes the follow-up owner.

cases.symptom: User has a blocked workflow and a support-safe evidence pack is ready.
cases.safeNextAction: Attach only support-safe fields and preserve the owner route, severity, and safe next action.
cases.customerSafeWording: A redacted support handoff is ready. It includes the owner route and excludes private payloads.
cases.escalationRoute: Support operator with severity, owner route, and redaction evidence.
accessibilityNotes: Severity and owner route are text-first and available outside color or icon state.

scopeOut: No support queue or ticket routing implementation.
No customer data or unredacted logs.
No launch claims without accepted evidence.
